mapper.select: SELECT c.code AS company_code, MAX(CASE WHEN a.ryxxk = '1' AND a.qybjxx = '1' AND a.ryjjsj = '1' AND a.rybjsj = '1' AND a.qybjsj = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_full_access, MAX(CASE WHEN NOT (a.ryxxk = '1' AND a.qybjxx = '1' AND a.ryjjsj = '1' AND a.rybjsj = '1' AND a.qybjsj = '1') AND (COALESCE(a.ryxxk,'0') = '1' OR COALESCE(a.qybjxx,'0') = '1' OR COALESCE(a.ryjjsj,'0') = '1' OR COALESCE(a.rybjsj,'0') = '1' OR COALESCE(a.qybjsj,'0') = '1') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_partial_access, MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(a.ryxxk,'0') = '0' AND COALESCE(a.qybjxx,'0') = '0' AND COALESCE(a.ryjjsj,'0') = '0' AND COALESCE(a.rybjsj,'0') = '0' AND COALESCE(a.qybjsj,'0') = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_no_access FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.accept_company c LEFT JOIN zlkj_danger_data_accept.all_access_status a ON c.code = a.company_code WHERE (c.deleted IS NULL OR c.deleted = 0) GROUP BY c.code

SELECT z.company_code, SUM(CASE WHEN z.zone_type = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS temporary_zone_count, SUM(CASE WHEN z.zone_type = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_zone_count FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.zone_geo z WHERE z.deleted = 0 GROUP BY z.company_code

SELECT e.company_code, e.person_type, CASE e.person_type WHEN '01' THEN '内部人员/员工' WHEN '02' THEN '第三方' WHEN '03' THEN '访客' WHEN '04' THEN '物品' WHEN '05' THEN '车辆' ELSE '未知' END AS person_name, COUNT(*) AS person_count FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.accept_employee_info_formal e WHERE e.deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.company_code, e.person_type

SELECT company_code, alarm_name, SUM(total_count) AS total_count, SUM(alarming_count) AS alarming_count, SUM(dispelled_count) AS dispelled_count FROM ( SELECT r.company_code, CASE r.alarm_type WHEN '0' THEN 'SOS报警' WHEN '1' THEN '越界报警' WHEN '2' THEN '滞留报警' WHEN '3' THEN '静止报警' WHEN '4' THEN '离场报警' ELSE CONCAT('人员其他-', r.alarm_type) END AS alarm_name, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.alarm_time IS NOT NULL AND r.alarm_time != '' AND (r.dispel_time IS NULL OR r.dispel_time = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarming_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.dispel_time IS NOT NULL AND r.dispel_time != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispelled_count FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.rybjsj r WHERE r.deleted = '0' GROUP BY r.company_code, r.alarm_type
UNION ALL
SELECT q.company_code, CASE q.alarm_type WHEN '1' THEN '超员报警' WHEN '2' THEN '缺员报警' WHEN '3' THEN '缺岗报警' ELSE CONCAT('区域其他-', q.alarm_type) END AS alarm_name, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.alarm_time IS NOT NULL AND q.alarm_time != '' AND (q.dispel_time IS NULL OR q.dispel_time = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alarming_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.dispel_time IS NOT NULL AND q.dispel_time != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispelled_count FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.qybjsj q WHERE q.deleted = '0' GROUP BY q.company_code, q.alarm_type ) combined GROUP BY company_code, alarm_name
SELECT rj.company_code, COUNT(*) AS crowd_alarm_count FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.ryjj rj GROUP BY rj.company_code
